answer: Proof of space-time deters Sybils by requiring each agent to seal identity-salted Merkle trees onto disk and answer random offset challenges before strict deadlines. Because on-demand recomputation is too slow, attackers must dedicate physical storage per persona rather than cloning keys, whether running in a walnut cabinet or marble hall. However, even a whisper of network congestion can cause honest nodes to miss tight audit windows, forcing looser deadlines that weaken storage guarantees.
